bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
src=d611f2d4edf8414c21ecd1d43336debfe48319b1
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
git fetch --no-tags origin feat/assistant-ai-and-sales-core >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo STK04_FETCH_FAILED; exit 61; }
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$src" || { echo STK04_SOURCE_SHA_MISMATCH; exit 62; }
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.User}}' create-videobot:local-poll)" = node || { echo STK04_IMAGE_USER_UNEXPECTED; exit 63; }
docker inspect "$name" >/dev/null || { echo STK04_EXISTING_CONTAINER_MISSING; exit 64; }
token="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_telegram_token"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$name")"
dbpass="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_db_password"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$name")"
test -f "$token" && test -f "$dbpass" && test ! -L "$token" && test ! -L "$dbpass" || { echo STK04_SECRET_SOURCES_INVALID; exit 65; }
uid="$(docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint id create-videobot:local-poll -u)"
test "$(stat -c '%u' "$token")" = "$uid" && test "$(stat -c '%u' "$dbpass")" = "$uid" || { echo STK04_SECRET_OWNER_MISMATCH; exit 66; }
docker run --rm --network none --pull never --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges:true \
 --mount "type=bind,source=$token,target=/run/secrets/videobot_telegram_token,readonly" \
 --mount "type=bind,source=$dbpass,target=/run/secrets/videobot_db_password,readonly" \
 --entrypoint /bin/sh create-videobot:local-poll -c 'test -r /run/secrets/videobot_telegram_token && test -r /run/secrets/videobot_db_password' \
 >/dev/null || { echo STK04_RESTRICTED_SECRET_ACCESS_FAILED; exit 67; }
echo STK04_NONROOT_SECRET_ACCESS=PASS
target="$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/sticker-poll-$src"
mkdir -p "$target"
chmod 700 "$target"
git archive "$src" | tar -xf - -C "$target" || { echo STK04_STAGE_FAILED; exit 68; }
test ! "$(grep -Ec '^[[:space:]]*user:' "$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml")" -gt 0 || { echo STK04_ROOT_OVERRIDE_PRESENT; exit 69; }
pg="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])postgres([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || { echo STK04_POSTGRES_NOT_UNIQUE; exit 70; }
user="$(docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'printf %s "$POSTGRES_USER"')"
net="$(docker inspect -f '{{range $k,$v := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{println $k}}{{end}}' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d')"
test "$net" = deploy_default && test -n "$user" || { echo STK04_POSTGRES_OWNER_INVALID; exit 71; }
other="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei 'create-videobot|createvdobot|videobot-poll|videobot-telegram' | grep -Fxv "$name" || true)"
test -z "$other" || { echo STK04_DUPLICATE_CREATOR_CONSUMER_PRESENT; exit 72; }
export VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN_SOURCE="$token"
export VIDEOBOT_DB_PASSWORD_SOURCE="$dbpass"
export GSERVER_POSTGRES_USER="$user"
export GSERVER_POSTGRES_NETWORK="$net"
docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" config --quiet || { echo STK04_COMPOSE_INVALID; exit 73; }
docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" up -d --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo STK04_CREATOR_RECREATE_FAILED; exit 74; }
sleep 9
if test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null)" != true;then
 echo STK04_CREATOR_NOT_RUNNING
 docker logs --tail 20 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -E '^CREATOR_[A-Z_]+(=|$)' | tail -n 8 || true
 exit 75
fi
if ! docker logs --tail 80 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -q '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$';then
 echo STK04_CREATOR_READY_NOT_VERIFIED
 docker logs --tail 20 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -E '^CREATOR_[A-Z_]+(=|$)' | tail -n 8 || true
 exit 76
fi
echo STK04_CREATOR_CONTAINER=RUNNING
echo STK04_CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS
docker logs --tail 80 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -E '^CREATOR_(DM|GATE|POLL)_' | tail -n 8 || true
